title: koeleria × pseudoglauca subsp. csatoi
intro: Koeleria × pseudoglauca subsp. csatoi, commonly known as Koeleria csatoi, is a hybrid of the Koeleria species, a type of grass. This plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria csatoi include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential therapeutic applications of Koeleria csatoi.
